project_name: Enterprise B2B Enrollment & Provider Operations Portal

design_direction.name: Precision Slate & Steel Teal (Tactical B2B Enterprise)
design_direction.rationale: Explicitly departs from generic Indigo/Slate/Plus Jakarta Sans. Designed specifically for high-density B2B operational workflows with crisp visual hierarchy, minimal scroll fatigue, precision data tables, and rapid completion speeds.
design_direction.theme: Light mode default with dark mode support, crisp 1px structural borders (#E2E8F0 / #1E293B), high contrast operational states

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

scale.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
scale.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
scale.overline: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout_architecture.shell_structure: Collapsible left sidebar + fixed top nav header with breadcrumbs + compact main content area
layout_architecture.spacing_philosophy: High density, zero scroll-fatigue. Use p-4 to p-6 for main panels, p-3 for cards, compact 32px height table rows.
layout_architecture.page_height: h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden (Internal scroll for data tables and multi-step forms)

shared_components_guidelines.header: Glassmorphic h-14 border-b border-slate-200/80 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md px-4 flex items-center justify-between z-40
shared_components_guidelines.page_header: Compact page header with title, status pill, breadcrumbs, and right-aligned quick action buttons. Height max 64px.
shared_components_guidelines.tables: AgGrid / React-Table styled with compact height rows (36px), stick headers, search filter bar, bulk action dropdown, and crisp column borders.
shared_components_guidelines.forms: Multi-step wizard layout with left progress tracker, inline field validation, structured input groups, clean select dropdowns, and sticky bottom action bar.
shared_components_guidelines.cards: Subtle border (border-slate-200), zero soft shadow bloat, 12px border radius (rounded-lg), high readability contrast.
shared_components_guidelines.modals: Scale-up dialogs with clear header, scrollable body area, and action footer with data-testid attributes.
shared_components_guidelines.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or squared-sm with crisp status borders and legible contrast.

module_order_and_layouts.key_layout_pattern: Split-panel layout: Left side filter & inward batch summary; Right side multi-step endorsement/policy wizard.
Tabbed workspace with summary stat cards at top, high-density AgGrid in middle, and side drawer for document/bank verification.
Nested accordion tree layout + high-density configuration grid with live validation preview.
Summary metric cards + dual listbox for role assignments + audit log slide-over panel.
Side nav settings sidebar with compact form sections and instant save switches.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select, tabs, table rows, badges, modal actions) MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='corporate-inward-submit-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility_standards: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio, full keyboard navigation support, focus-ring-2 focus-ring-teal-500 focus-ring-offset-1.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild shared layout shell first: Replace old sidebar with collapsible left menu organized into the 4 module groups.
Apply global color system: Teal (#0D9488) as primary accent, Slate (#0F172A) for sidebar/headers, Soft Gray (#F8FAFC) for backgrounds.
Ensure Javascript / React (.js/.jsx) compatibility across all component modifications.
Ensure every operational button, modal trigger, filter input, and table row has a distinct data-testid attribute.
Keep pages compact and data-dense without long unnecessary marketing scrolling.
